decisions.reason: As the publicly announced flagship of the firm's innovative direction, it carries high commitment and sunk costs, so management will persist rather than drop it early.

Despite only a website mention, the stackable crate line involves significant engineering resources and fits the core portfolio, so the firm will justify and continue it.
The rackable pallet line has sunk development costs and aligns with the firm's logistics focus, leading management to persist to avoid wasted investment.
